faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions before we start

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: It depends on the scope: a brochure site usually takes a few weeks, a custom application takes longer. The exact schedule is agreed when we start, before the first line of code.

items.question: How does a project run?
items.answer: Five stages: discussion and scoping, a detailed quote, design (mockups and architecture), development with regular check-ins, then launch. You validate each stage before moving to the next.

items.question: How do I get a quote?
items.answer: The quote is free and non-binding. Describe your project through the form or on WhatsApp: I get back to you to scope the need, then send a detailed quote (scope, schedule, price). No payment is requested before you approve it.

items.question: Do you provide maintenance after launch?
items.answer: Yes, as an option: updates, bug fixes, backups and improvements. The terms (frequency, scope, price) are set in the quote, and one-off support remains available even without a contract.

items.question: Who handles hosting and the domain name?
items.answer: I point you to a host that fits your budget and can handle the launch. The domain name and hosting are registered in your name: you keep ownership of your website and its data.

items.question: I have no texts or photos, is that a problem?
items.answer: No. I help you structure the content (copy, images, pages) and tell you what to prepare. Content is a stage of the project, not a prerequisite.
